premises.text: In-car technology goes obsolete quickly and owners cannot upgrade without buying a new car, leaving over a billion vehicles behind
premises.evidence_span: aren't you afraid that a year from now, this technology will be completely outdated, and the only way to change that is to buy a new car

premises.text: A small plug-in device plus Vinly app catalog turns post-1996 cars into connected cars that can run apps immediately
premises.evidence_span: The VINLY platform uses this small device to connect and communicate with your car

premises.text: Day-one first-party apps cover safety, money-saving, and fun driving use cases on the platform
premises.evidence_span: We already built a number of apps on the platform so consumers can use Vinly from day one

premises.text: Consumer hardware is sold at $49.99 basic and $149.99 complete tiers
premises.evidence_span: $49.99 for our vinly basic device, at $149.99 for our vinly complete

premises.text: Enterprises can plug Vinly into fleets for business apps such as Fleet Tracker at $149.99 per year including device and data
premises.evidence_span: companies can buy Vinly devices, plug it into their fleet, and start using business applications

premises.text: An open developer platform with a simple API lets developers build connected-car apps across makes and models without OEM silos
premises.evidence_span: developers can build applications for the connected car, regardless of their make and model, because we simplified the complicated car into a simple API call

value.text: Existing cars become smarter with connected apps and services without buying a new car
value.evidence_span: make a car manufactured after 1996, which is almost every car on the road right now, smarter than a car that just left the assembly line

causal_links.evidence_span: What about more than one billion vehicles on the road right now
download the Vinly app catalog and start using apps right away
applications like Fleet Tracker, which enables them to manage and track their fleet
enable developers to get a huge piece of this market
